newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks pause for breath, eye Thurs holiday.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks pause for breath, eye Thurs holiday.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed lower on Wednesday, taking a rest after heady gains of recent weeks ahead of a local public holiday on Thursday, dealers said.

Better than expected inflation data --1.7 percent year on year in April versus 2.2 percent in March-- paved the way for consolidation today, reinforcing widespread expectations for a 25 basis point rate cut on Friday, they added.
The general index fell 1.24 points, 0.23 percent, to 546.76 and the Ibex-35 dropped 19.88 points, 0.31 percent, to 6,304.36.
Iberdrola fell 15 pesetas to 1,725 after announcing a five percent fall in first quarter results.
Repsol gained 20 pesetas to 6,060 after a 12 percent drop in first quarter earnings announced yesterday, due to atypical factors and not seen denting full year results, analysts said.
The fresh decline in the inflation rate was well-received by the bourse, which took the opportunity to consolidate after long-held expectations for a benign April figure were confirmed.
But dealers see room for stocks to climb yet higher.
"The market needed to calm down after such big gains recently, but medium term the outlook is still positive," said one.
